source_status: Third-party archive claiming Dukascopy provenance; original-feed authentication unavailable. Exploratory evidence only.
holdout_end_basis: Archive metadata advertises last available date 2026-08-20, not latest direct-provider data.
flat_candle_rule: Exclude M1 rows where both bid and ask OHLC are entirely flat. Cannot distinguish padding from genuine quiet minutes without ticks.
invalid_quote_rule: Reject nonpositive prices, invalid OHLC inequalities, or nonpositive endpoint spreads.
suspicious_quote_rule: Flag spread > 5 USD/oz or adjacent midpoint-open log jump > 2%; exclude affected research/candidate sessions, no interpolation.
hypothesis_gate: Development BH q<0.05, expected sign, economic floor; validation p<0.05, same sign and >=50% development magnitude. No tradable-edge acceptance on unauthenticated archive alone.
candidate_status: Externally specified Tokyo Coil benchmark, not a strategy inferred from passing H1-H6

candidate.news_calendar_status: UNAVAILABLE: 08:00 is a fixed-exit adaptation; 12:00 omits news flattening and is a diagnostic only
candidate.quantity_mode: continuous ounces; not a broker lot-accurate test
